steps.title: GovGrid
steps.subtitle: AI-Powered DPI Public Budget Reconciliation
steps.caption: GovGrid: AI-Powered Digital Public Infrastructure
steps.narration: Welcome to GovGrid. Autonomous budget reconciliation for municipal digital public infrastructure.

steps.caption: Executive Briefing: Real-time municipal capital oversight
steps.narration: GovGrid reconciles citizen distress signals directly against municipal e-procurement contracts.

steps.caption: Spatial Priority Matrix: Identifying infrastructure anomalies
steps.narration: Active distress clusters are automatically prioritized by severity and geographic impact.

steps.caption: Command Palette: Instant navigation across civic datasets
steps.narration: Administrators search tenders, statutory audits, and citizen records in milliseconds.

steps.caption: Jan-Vani: Grassroots Vernacular Voice Processing
steps.narration: Citizens report infrastructure damage in Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi via WhatsApp voice notes.

steps.caption: Vertex AI Chirp 2: Vernacular Indic language processing
steps.narration: Chirp two transcribes colloquial Indic dialects with ninety-eight percent phonetic accuracy.

steps.caption: Audio Playback: High-fidelity citizen distress verification
steps.narration: Audio evidence is verified with geocoded coordinates before cross-referencing public procurement.

steps.caption: Tender Audits: Cross-referencing GeM public contracts
steps.narration: GovGrid surfaces contractors billing for completed road repairs where citizen grievances persist.

steps.caption: Forensic Discrepancy Dossier: Automated evidence binding
steps.narration: Discrepancy reports compile satellite imagery, citizen testimony, and billing records.

steps.caption: GFR Rule 175: Instant statutory payment freeze
steps.narration: Commissioners freeze milestone tranches with one click under municipal financial statutory rules.

steps.caption: BigQuery GIS: ST_DWithin 500-meter buffer analysis
steps.narration: BigQuery GIS maps citizen complaint clusters directly against active geospatial tender polygons.

steps.caption: Geospatial Reconciliation: Visualizing contractor compliance
steps.narration: Interactive maps expose infrastructure gaps that traditional municipal audits miss entirely.

steps.caption: Civic Knowledge Base: Transparent open governance
steps.narration: Complete documentation of algorithmic audit rules, legal frameworks, and grievance resolution pathways.

steps.title: GovGrid
steps.subtitle: Live DPI at govgrid.web.app • Season 2
steps.caption: Built for Code for Communities Season 2 • Track 1
steps.narration: GovGrid brings accountable transparency to public funds. Live now at govgrid dot web dot app.
